spans.s:
ind.
A particle of abuse or contempt.
E.
the neuter of न्यञ्च् used as a particle.

n. (-णं)
Treating with disrespect or contempt.
E.
न्यक्, and करण making.

m. (-रः)
Contempt, disrespect.
E.
न्यङ् little, low, कृ to make, aff. घञ्.

f. (-का)
An insect found in ordure.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
1 Whole, entire.
2 Low, inferior.
m. (-क्षः)
1 A name of

PARAŚURĀMA.
2

A buffalo.
n. (-क्षं)
1 A hole.
2 Grass.
E.
नि before अक्ष a die, &c.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Of mean or inferior race.
E.
न्यक्, and जाति cast.

Contempt.
2

Defiling.
E.
न्धक्, and भावन conceiving.

m. (-धः)
1 The Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.)
2 A fathom measured by the arms extended.
3 The Śami, (Mimosa albida.)
f. (-धी)
1 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata, Rox.)
2 A medical plant, commonly Mohānā.
E.
न्यक् short, रुध to impede, aff. अण्.

f. (-ला)
An elegant woman.

m. (-ङ्कुः)
1 A deer.
2 The name of a saint or Muni.
E.
नि always, अञ्च to go, aff. कु.

m. (-हः)
A tree, (Cassia fistula.)
E.
न्यङ्कु a deer, and भूरुह a tree.

n. (-ङ्गं)
Low abuse.
E.
न्यङ्, and ग what goes or is.

mfn. (न्यङ् नीची न्यक्)
1 Short, dwarfish.
2 Low, vile, contemptible, base.
3 Slow, lazy.
4 Whole, entire.
E.
नि prefixed to अञ्च to go, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Thrown or cast down.
E.
नि before, अञ्चित gone.

m. (-यः)
Loss, expense, waste, destruction.
E.
नि before इ to go, aff. अच्.

m. (-यः)
1 Propriety, fitness.
2 The Nyāya doctrine, logic, logical philosophy.
3 Apposite illustration.
4 A complete argument or syllogism.
5 Policy, good government.
E.
नि certainly, इन् to go, aff घञ्.

mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं)
Right, proper, fit.
E.
न्याय, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-र्ण्णः-र्ण्णा-र्ण्णं)
1 Asked, solicited.
2

Gone.
3

Injured.
E.
नि, अर्द्द to ask, क्त aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Delivering, giving up.
2 Depositing.
E.
नि before अस to throw, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Deposited, consigned, delivered.
2 Placed in or upon.
3 Applied to.
E.
नि before अस to throw or send, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं)
Unarmed, defenceless, having laid down or resigned weapons.
m. (-स्त्रः)
A deified progenitor.
E.
न्यस्त delivered, and शस्त्र a weapon.

n. (-क्यं)
Fried rice.

m. (-दः)
Eating, feeding.
E.
नि before अद to eat, अण aff.

f. (-ता)
Fitness, propriety.
E.
तल् added to न्याय; also with त्व न्यायत्वं.

f. (-णी)
A woman acting or judging rightly.
E.
न्याय propriety, सारिणी proceeding.

m. (-रः)
A virtuous man.
E.
न्याय, and आचार observance.

m. (-रः)
An example of virtue or propriety.
E.
न्याय, and आधार what upholds.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Right, fit.
2 Logical.
E.
न्याय, and इनि aff.

m. (-सः)
1 A deposit, a pledge.
2 Deserting, abandoning.
3 Delivering, presenting.
4 Mental delivering, consigning or entrusting any thing to the mind.
5 Mental appropriation or assignment of various parts of the body to tutelary divinities, accompanied with certain prayers and gesticulations.
E.
नि before अस to throw or cast away, aff. घञ्.

m. (-री)
The holder of a deposit, a mortgagee.
E.
न्यास, and धारिन् who has.
